title: Cancel Order – Slot-Based – Full Cancellation (Only Order for Student Course) – Lesson Allocation Archived, Not Deleted
description: Gap/update case - Decision Table, contrasts with the legacy-wording baseline (case 9922, "Slot-Based – LA Deleted, Student Removed from Lessons") - when Enable_Lesson_Allocation_Archive__c is enabled, cancelling the only order for a student-course does not delete the Lesson Allocation record; it archives it. The record remains reachable by Id, excluded from active lists, with its Class Member/Student Session children hidden via the Is_Archived__c formula rather than removed.
preconditions:
- Student A has a Slot-Based order for Course A with Require Allocation = True (the only order for this student-course). An individual lesson exists with Student A assigned.
- Lesson_Custom_Settings__c.Enable_Lesson_Allocation_Archive__c = TRUE in this org.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the order group detail for the Slot-Based product, clicks "Cancel", saves draft, and submits"
2. "HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's Lesson Allocation directly by record Id"
3. "HQ or CM Staff navigates to Student A's Course tab / Lesson Allocation list"
4. "HQ or CM Staff opens the individual lesson Student A was assigned to"
steps_result:
1. "The order is cancelled"
2. "The Lesson Allocation still exists and is reachable; Archived_At__c is populated"
3. "The Lesson Allocation no longer appears in the active list"
4. "Student A is removed from the lesson's Student Sessions, same end-user-visible outcome as the legacy "deleted" baseline (case 9922)"
steps_data:
1. "Order status = Cancelled"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp; record NOT deleted"
3. "Archived LA excluded from active-list queries (Archived_At__c = NULL filter)"
4. "Student A's Student Session Is_Archived__c = TRUE (via formula) -> hidden, not deleted"

title: Cancel Order – New Order Submitted After Full Cancellation – Archived Lesson Allocation Restored, Not Re-Created
description: Gap case - Decision Table - continuing from the scenario above: when a new order is later submitted for the same student-course (e.g. the family re-enrolls), LessonAllocationSyncService restores the SAME archived Lesson Allocation record (unarchive) rather than creating a brand-new one, since the record for that student-course already exists.
preconditions:
- Following directly from the case above: Student A's Lesson Allocation for Course A is archived (Archived_At__c populated) after the only order was cancelled. Note its record Id.
- Enable_Lesson_Allocation_Archive__c = TRUE.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff submits a new order for Student A on the same Course A student-course"
2. "HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's Lesson Allocation for Course A"
3. "HQ or CM Staff navigates to Student A's Course tab / Lesson Allocation list"
steps_result:
1. "The order is submitted successfully"
2. "The SAME Lesson Allocation record (same record Id as before) now shows Archived_At__c blank - it was restored, not replaced by a new record"
3. "The Lesson Allocation reappears in the active list"
steps_data:
1. "New order for Course A"
2. "Archived_At__c = null (restored); record Id unchanged from the archived state"
3. "Is_Archived__c = FALSE (via formula) -> visible again"

title: Cancel Order – Partial Cancellation (Future Effective Date, Order Not Removed) – Lesson Allocation End Date Updated Only, Not Archived
description: Regression / boundary case - Decision Table, contrasts with the existing baseline (case 1777, "Frequency – Future Effective Date – LA End Date Updated") - cancelling an order with a future effective date only shortens the Lesson Allocation's end date; the order itself is not removed (it still has valid Start/End dates until the effective date), so shouldArchiveAllocationOfStudentCourse's "all orders removed" condition is never satisfied and Archived_At__c is never touched. This locks in that the archive mechanism introduced by this epic has no effect on this already-covered partial-cancel behavior.
preconditions:
- Student A has a Frequency order for Course A with Require Allocation = True and a class assigned; Student A is auto-assigned to lessons by class.
- Enable_Lesson_Allocation_Archive__c = TRUE.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the order group detail, clicks "Cancel", fills in an effective date in the future (after today, before the order's original end date), saves draft, and submits"
2. "HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's Lesson Allocation"
3. "HQ or CM Staff navigates to Student A's Course tab / Lesson Allocation list"
steps_result:
1. "The order's end date is updated to the effective date"
2. "End_Date_Time__c is updated to the effective date; Archived_At__c remains blank throughout"
3. "The Lesson Allocation still appears in the active list, unaffected by the archive mechanism"
steps_data:
1. "effective_date > today"
2. "Archived_At__c = null; only duration fields changed"
3. "Is_Archived__c = FALSE (via formula) -> unaffected"
